title: Vue 3 + Vite app scaffold + graph store
description:
Scaffold the front-end: Vue 3 + Vite + Vue Router + Pinia + TypeScript, in an `app/` (or `web/`) folder. Load the ingestion `graph.json` into a Pinia store on startup with typed accessors: nodesByType(type), nodeById(id), edgesFrom(id), edgesTo(id), neighbors(id, rel?). Add a basic app shell (header, nav, router-view) and a home page showing the ingestion summary stats (counts by type) so a non-technical user immediately sees the scope of the data. Keep it read-only. Design should be clean and approachable (this is a 'personal Wikipedia', not a dev tool).

Part of Phase 2 (UI foundation). Stack: Vue 3 + Vite, deploy target Firebase.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run dev` serves a Vue 3 app that loads graph.json and renders without console errors
Pinia store exposes typed accessors: nodesByType, nodeById, edgesFrom, edgesTo, neighbors
Home page displays live counts by node type read from the loaded graph
App shell has header + navigation + router-view; routing between at least two pages works
Build (`npm run build`) produces a static bundle suitable for Firebase Hosting

comments.author: orchestrator
